parameters.name: AlertTemplates
parameters.description: The details of the alert template.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the alert template.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description:
The name of the alert template.

For information about how to obtain the name of an alert template, see [DescribeMetricRuleTemplateList](~~114982~~).

parameters.name: RestVersion
parameters.description:
The version of the alert template. The version changes with the number of times that the alert template is modified.

For information about how to obtain the version of an alert template, see [DescribeMetricRuleTemplateList](~~114982~~).

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description:
The ID of the alert template.

For information about how to obtain the ID of an alert template, see [DescribeMetricRuleTemplateList](~~114982~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cms modify-metric-rule-template --template-id 123456 --name Template_123 --description ECS_template1 --rest-version 1 --alert-templates MetricName=cpu_total ComparisonOperator=GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold Category=ecs Times=2 Period=60 Webhook=http://www.aliyun.com Statistics=Average Namespace=acs_ecs_dashboard RuleName=Rule_123 Threshold=20 Selector=disk_:_/ --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cms ModifyMetricRuleTemplate --region cn-hangzhou --AlertTemplates.1.Statistics Average --Description ECS_template1 --AlertTemplates.1.RuleName Rule_123 --AlertTemplates.1.MetricName cpu_total --RestVersion 1 --AlertTemplates.1.Times 2 --AlertTemplates.1.Threshold 20 --Name Template_123 --AlertTemplates.1.Selector 'disk_:_/' --AlertTemplates.1.Webhook 'http://www.aliyun.com' --AlertTemplates.1.Period 60 --AlertTemplates.1.Category ecs --AlertTemplates.1.Namespace acs_ecs_dashboard --AlertTemplates.1.ComparisonOperator GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold --TemplateId 123456
